items.headline: Albemarle Upgrade: Can Energy Storage Recharge Lithium's Leader?
items.snippet: The next catalyst is close. Albemarle reports third-quarter results on Nov. 4. Of the 26 analysts covering the stock, 16 rate it Buy or Strong Buy; Mizuho upgraded to Outperform with a $130 target.

items.headline: Lithium's $100 Billion Supply Gap Hands Albemarle a Domestic Moat
items.snippet: Battery storage is building a second floor of demand, and Western reshoring gives established domestic producers like Albemarle Corporation (NYSE:ALB) outsized leverage. In Q2 Energy Storage volumes rose 11% while realized price jumped 61% to $19.53/kg.

items.headline: Albemarle has surprising new reason to rally
items.snippet: Mizuho raised its 2027 lithium demand estimate by almost 10%, driven by grid battery storage buildout.

items.headline: Albemarle Corporation(ALB) Zacks Company Report
items.snippet: Albemarle faces headwinds from weaker Energy Storage volumes, falling lithium prices and rising supply-chain costs; Zacks keeps an Underperform view.

items.headline: Albemarle price target lowered to $135 from $230 at Argus
items.snippet: Argus lowered the price target on Albemarle to $135 from $230 and keeps a Buy rating; lithium is up about 67% y/y but well below highs, supply/demand seen improving into 2027.
